claims.verbatim:
Steamship Pereire (Fr.), Duchesne, from Havre and Brest Sept. 1,
at 4 p. m., with mdse. and pass. to George Mackenzie. Sept. 7, lat.
44 55, long. 55 from Paris, saw a steamship supposed to be one of the
National Line, bound E; 8th, lat. 42 50, long. 62, a National Line
steamship bound W; 8th, lat. 42 30, long. 64 30, passed steamship Ful-
ton for New-York.

claims.citation: Hubbard & Winter, North Atlantic Mail Sailings 1840-75 (USPCS, 1988; rev. 2014), p. 278
